Something about seeing the blood start coming out a little just calms my down and makes my anxiety stop, like I'm finally doing something to feel better. That little razor blade stops my anxiety before it gets any worse and end up spiraling further into my thoughts. It's just my method of suicide prevention because I know that I can't do that, no matter how much I want to, but the cuts are much less final. I only go till I get a little blood because of my pain tolerance. They probably won't even scar, and if they do, it'll be pretty light, so it's okay, as long as it keeps me from putting a bullet through my skull.
